title: Glimm
description: Shader-driven page transitions: an iridescent WebGL band sweeps across the window or one box, revealing the incoming view behind it while the outgoing view stays ahead. A React provider and hook over a framework-agnostic core.

loop.script: click[0] → wait → wait → wait → click[3] → click[0] → wait → wait → wait → click[1] → click[0] → wait

props.name: palette
props.description: GlimmProvider: the band's colors; also a per-sweep option. Build your own with accentPair, accentChain or shuffleAccentPalette.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the band travels. The first four are physical, as upstream; inline-end and inline-start follow the reading direction, so a forward sweep runs right to left in RTL.

props.name: sweepMs / outroMs / midpoint
props.description: Time for the band to cross, the fade after it, and the progress point (0 to 1) where the swap is committed.

props.name: bandTight / peakAlpha / brightness / swellAmount / waveAmount / rippleAmount / waveSpeed
props.description: The band's sharpness, peak opacity, brightness (lower it on dark pages), crest depth, edge wave, ripple texture and motion speed.

props.name: scope
props.description: viewport (upstream): the band crosses the window and the page is held with View Transitions. container: the band crosses the provider's own box (set its size with className) and its content is held as a frozen copy, so a transition can live inside a card or dialog.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Under prefers-reduced-motion: swap at once (upstream), play the sweep anyway, or fade the new view in over the old one.

props.name: fallback
props.description: When WebGL cannot draw (no context, or a lost one): wipe the view without the band, or swap at once (upstream).

props.name: shaderFactory / onController / zIndex
props.description: Swap the look (createMeshShader), receive the controller for live tuning, and set the overlay's z-index (9999 for the viewport, 2 in a container).

props.name: useGlimm().sweep(navigate, options?)
props.type: (navigate: () => void | Promise<void>, options?: SweepOptions & { focus?: string | HTMLElement | (() => HTMLElement | null) }) => { midpoint, done, cancel }
props.description: Plays one transition: runs your navigation, waits for React to commit it, reveals the new view, and returns a handle. focus moves focus to the new view once it is committed.

a11y: The canvas layer and the frozen copy of the outgoing view are aria-hidden, inert, and never reachable by keyboard; the live view underneath is the only interactive one.
Pass focus to sweep() to move focus to the new view's heading once it is committed (a heading gets tabindex -1); upstream does not move focus.
Reduced motion: the default swaps at once, or reducedMotion="crossfade" fades the new view in over the old one in 180 ms; nothing travels across the view.
Without WebGL, or after the context is lost, a sweep runs the same masks without the band (fallback="wipe"), or swaps at once (fallback="instant").
inline-end and inline-start make the direction follow dir, so the band moves in reading order in right-to-left pages.
Pointer input is blocked while a transition runs and keyboard focus is never trapped.
usage:
<GlimmProvider palette="prism">
  <App />
</GlimmProvider>

const { sweep } = useGlimm();
<button onClick={() => sweep(() => setView("next"))}>Next</button>
